description_en: Calls UpdateRoom to update all modifiable information of a room
description_zh: 调用UpdateRoom更新房间所有可修改信息
name: UpdateRoom

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the application. The value can contain lowercase letters and digits, and must be 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 应用唯一标识，可以包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The room ID. The value can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.). The maximum length is 36 characters
parameters.help_zh: 房间ID，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.），最大长度36个字符
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.help_en: The room title. The value supports both Chinese and English characters, with a maximum length of 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 房间标题，支持中英文，最大长度32个字符
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The room notice. The value supports both Chinese and English characters, with a maximum length of 256 characters
parameters.help_zh: 房间公告，支持中英文，最大长度256个字符
parameters.name: notice

parameters.help_en: The ID of the room owner. The value can contain only letters and digits, with a maximum length of 36 characters
parameters.help_zh: 房主ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符
parameters.name: room_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The extension field. Pass this parameter as needed to record additional room properties
parameters.help_zh: 拓展字段，按需传递，需要额外记录的房间属性
parameters.name: extension
